description: This repo dogfoods its own org-shared preset (default.json, consumed elsewhere as `github>FS-GG/.github`) instead of vanilla config:recommended, so the dist/dotnet pins it distributes are managed under the same semantics every product repo gets — dependency dashboard, semantic commits, and FS.GG.* feed/grouping/prerelease routing (review M9, #132). The FS.GG.* rules are inert here today (no FS.GG.* PackageReferences), but self-applying the preset keeps the asymmetry from silently returning.
